questions.question_text: Case 1: Mom has 56 snacks. She shares them equally into 7 bags. How many snacks are in each bag?
questions.question_text_en: Case 1: Mom has 56 snacks. She shares them equally into 7 bags. How many snacks are in each bag?
questions.explanation: Use division: 56 ÷ 7 = 8. Each bag has 8 snacks.
questions.explanation_en: Use division: 56 ÷ 7 = 8. Each bag has 8 snacks.
questions.hint_th: อ่านโจทย์แล้วหาตัวเลขสำคัญ
